items.scene: A grey-haired waitress tips a tall glass CARAFE (kah-RAHF) of water into a tumbler on the little table, the stress landing on the end: ka-RAFF!
The BARMAN (bahr-MAHN) with a curly moustache rattles his silver shaker so hard it seems to shout 'BAR! MAN!'
GERRY the university DON (gay-ree-DOHN), in a black gown and mortarboard, holds his teacup beside a SMALL ROUND TABLE.
A giant glass of fizzy SODA bubbles over the rim, SO DAzzling (soh-DAH) it sprays the wallpaper.
A BEAVER (bew-VUHR), the café's biggest milk DRINKER, proudly holds a giant glass of cold MILK in both paws in front of his chest and grins with his two orange front teeth.
Two cheerful APES (ah-pay-ROH) at a little table with bowls of crisps and peanuts hold up glasses of orange juice with an orange slice: their evening APÉRO, no grown-up drinks in sight.
A bearded wizard waves his wand and BREWS a bubbling purple POTION in a glass VASE (bruh-VAHZH): BREW-VASE.
A burger and a box of fries wait on a red tray on the counter: FAST FOOD (fahst-FOOD), ready the moment you order.
A kitten fans away a puff of FUMES (nohn-few-MUHR) with a paper fan: she is a strict NON-SMOKER.
